Long, wavy bubblegum pink hair with thick bangs and a side-part. Wide, innocent pale blue eyes. Apparent age in the late teens with a soft, youthful face. Slender, petite build. Wears a white and gold cleric's robe with a long flowing cape and a red ribbon at the neck. Carries a white wooden staff topped with a gold ornament.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
